newsitem.title: LATVIA: LITHUANIA-ECONOMY NEEDS FINAL PUSH, VILNIAUS SAYS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-ECONOMY NEEDS FINAL PUSH, VILNIAUS SAYS.

text.p: Lithuania's economy needs one final push to keep it on the path of recovery and ensure long-term, stable growth, leading commercial bank Vilniaus Bank said in its most recent monthly macroeconomic review.
"A visible turnaround (in the economy) might start as soon as this year," the bank said in its May report.
The bank noted that most of the macroeconomic conditions were in place for sustained growth, including declining inflation and rising real incomes and wages.
But it said that with stabilisation achieved, a big drive was needed to attract capital.

"The experience of other transition economies shows that growth recovers shortly after stabilisation. But one last big effort is needed if that recovery is to be strong and long-lasting," the bank said.
"Previous governments failed to set favourable conditions for the accumulation of capital needed for the restructuring of the economy," the bank said.

"The Lithuanian economy needs relatively large investments, as its structure is dominated by cost intensive companies in the energy sector and food processing companies which have to allot part of their funds for management of the raw material basis," the bank added.
